Baked mushroom rice

Original EZEATS recipe · editorially reviewed draft · owner review required · not kitchen-tested.

Rice absorbs mushroom broth in a covered oven dish with thyme.

European-inspired · dinner, rice · moderate

Servings: 2

Prep: 10 min

Cook: 45 min

Total: 55 min (estimate)

Estimated cost: USD 4 per serving. Not a price quote or a CAD conversion.

Diet and allergy suitability: unverified. Ingredient-list screening only, for the exact products specified. Brands, substitutions and cross-contact can change suitability. Editorial review is not kitchen testing or a medical or allergy-safety guarantee.

Known allergens: No listed major allergens. This list may be incomplete; check package labels and cross-contact.

Before you cook

  • Before starting, wash hands with soap and water for 20 seconds. Rinse fresh produce under running water and use clean utensils.
  • Check every packaged ingredient label for dietary requirements and allergens, including cross-contact notices. Choose products with no additional allergenic ingredients beyond the warnings listed here; otherwise these ingredient-based recommendations no longer apply. Listed tags apply only to the specified ingredients; they are not allergy-safe guarantees.
  • Refrigerate perishable ingredients until needed. Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within 2 hours (within 1 hour above 90°F/32°C); reheat leftovers to 74°C/165°F.

Ingredients

  • 3/4 cup dry long-grain white rice (Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 12 ounces mushrooms (340 g, sliced)
  • 1 1/2 cups canned white beans (Drained and rinsed; quantities are drained. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1 3/4 cups gluten-free vegan vegetable broth (Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1/2 medium yellow onion (diced)
  • 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme

Cooking instructions

  1. Heat the oven to 375°F/190°C. Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe pot on medium-high and brown the mushrooms and yellow onion for 8 minutes.
  2. Stir in the dry long-grain white rice and dried thyme for 1 minute, then add the gluten-free vegan vegetable broth and canned white beans. Bring to a simmer.
  3. Cover tightly and bake for 30 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid absorbed. Keep the lid on while cooking.
  4. Rest covered off heat for 5 minutes, then fluff gently and divide between bowls.
